data.name: Sanku
data.gender_notes: Sanku is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sanku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'San', which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity', and 'Ku', which means 'god'. Thus, Sanku can be interpreted as 'God of Wealth'. The name Sanku carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sanku usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sanku is a powerful name with deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents the divine power of abundance and prosperity. It is believed that the name Sanku bestows upon the bearer the blessings of the wealth god and ensures financial stability and success in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Sanku belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanku total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Sanku is an auspicious name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, reminiscent of the deity Ganesha, who is also known as Sankat-Narakahara, or the destroyer of obstacles. He is regarded as the patron of arts, knowledge, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Sanku or the elephant head of Lord Ganesha is associated with wisdom and strength, symbolizing the power and success that comes from wisdom and knowledge. This name has been popular among Hindus due to its rich cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sanku carries significant spiritual meaning for Hindus, representing the divine blessings of the God of Wealth, who is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and fortune into one's life. This name reflects the faith that spiritual enrichment and material success are interconnected. The spiritual significance of the name Sanku reminds us to seek the inner riches of wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment, while also encouraging the confidence that material wealth and prosperity will follow.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sanku: The name Sanku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shanka', which means a conch shell. It is a symbol of Lord Vishnu and represents the divine sound of creation. One who bears this name is believed to possess the power of bringing about change and transformation, just like the sound produced by the blowing of a conch shell in auspicious ceremonies.
